gre_general.value: Doctoral applicants need a GRE percentile of at least 60 in Quantitative and in Verbal.

toefl_min.value: The MAE admission page lists TOEFL iBT 79 for doctoral applicants, the old-scale figure, so check with the department.

english_waiver.value: An applicant whose medium of instruction was English may skip the English test, if the transcript says so.
english_waiver.quote: whose medium of instruction was English | must be notated on transcripts

supervisor.value: The MAE pages do not say whether an advisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page mentions available department funding for priority files but does not state a funding rule.

entry_route.value: The page lists undergraduate prerequisites for doctoral entry but does not say whether a master's is needed.
